scenes.title: A boat at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn offers passage for two silver at first light tomorrow and refuses to row at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, and her grandmother reported warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the flooded mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine and the cliff path
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and hymn-book pages, including one marked 'M. Brand'; Teo identifies the handwriting as his sister Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement, but find no further evidence; Oren takes damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The bell beneath the bay
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest.
